answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 20 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in yarrow, verified in zenith, and pulse names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 8 hours of verification and 18 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
